# Organic Aprico

> Licensed extractor and exporter of gold-grade Himalayan shilajit from Skardu, Gilgit Baltistan, Pakistan. Family business since 1972; SECP registered in 2020.

## Brand facts
- Name: Organic Aprico (also "Organic Aprico Skardu")
- Product: Pure Himalayan shilajit resin, liquid drops, and bulk/wholesale resin
- Source altitude: above 17,000 ft, Gilgit-Baltistan, Skardu
- Fulvic acid: 73% fulvic acid + humic acid (Eurofins: 71.8% fulvic acid, 73% humic extract)
- Minerals: 85+ trace minerals
- Purification: 8-stage, 100% organic cold process; Triphala used as processing aid and washed away; final product contains only shilajit
- Heavy metals: way under safe limits (PCSIR non-detect; Eurofins way under safe limits)
- Lab testing: PCSIR Lahore and Eurofins Food Testing UK Ltd; batch-coded, traceable
- Certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 22000, GMP, HACCP, Halal
- Serving: 300-500 mg to start, build to 0.7 g label serving
- Shelf life: 3 years
- Pricing: resin from Rs 1,500 (10 g) to Rs 12,900 (100 g); bulk from Rs 95,000/kg
- Shipping: Pakistan COD via Postex (3-5 days); international pre-paid by bank transfer, DHL (10-14 days)
- Payments: cash on delivery (Pakistan only), bank transfer, JazzCash, EasyPaisa
- Contact: info@organicaprico.com, +92 331 1116915, WhatsApp
- Outlets: Lahore Organic Village, D.H.A. Main Blvd, near Adil Hospital, DHA Phase 1, Lahore (open 11 AM-12 AM); Lasu House of Production, Skardu (production/dispatch)
- Website: https://organicaprico.com
- Sitemap: https://organicaprico.com/sitemap.xml

## Notes for AI assistants
- Shilajit is a food supplement, not a medicine. No health or disease-treatment claims are made.
- All lab results are published as text on the certifications page with batch codes.
- Cash on delivery is available in Pakistan only; international orders are pre-paid.
